title: Diljit Dosanjh is on the Coachella 2027 Friday bill on both weekends (9 and 16 April 2027; Dua Lipa headlines Fridays, Tame Impala Saturday, SZA Sunday); passes on sale Fri 13 Nov 12 pm PT = 1:30 am IST Sat 14 Nov (coachella.com); Tier 2 GA $779 with shuttle, VIP $1,399 (W1) / $1,349 (W2); Empire Polo Club, Indio; his 2023 debut made him the first Punjabi artist to play Coachella
